_about: Builder steps whose command is not run on the example data by tests/notebooks/test_builder_examples.py, each with the reason. Every other builder step is run there exactly as the builder shows it.

reasons.METAL|METAL: No example summary statistics for several cohorts yet; the command has placeholder paths.
reasons.ems_prediction|predict: Not yet implemented: gems_pipeline.R --step predict prints a notice and writes no scores.
reasons.mnm_regression|mvfsusie: Work in progress in the module itself.
reasons.qr_and_twas|quantile_qtl_twas_weight: Coming soon: qQTLR does not yet work with the current pecotmr release.
reasons.reference_data_preparation|download_dbsn: Downloads the dbSNP VCF, 16 GB; tests/notebooks/reference_data/test_download_urls.py checks that the URL still answers, without downloading it.
reasons.reference_data_preparation|download_gene: Downloads the Ensembl 103 GTF, 49 MB compressed; tests/notebooks/reference_data/test_download_urls.py checks that the URL still answers, without downloading it.
reasons.reference_data_preparation|download_hg_r: Downloads the GRCh38 FASTA, 3.3 GB; tests/notebooks/reference_data/test_download_urls.py checks that the URL still answers, without downloading it.
reasons.twas_ctwas|quantile_twas: Coming soon: needs the quantile TWAS weights from qr_and_twas.
